Container.Name: bahi
Container.Overview: Bahi: see your TallyPrime ledgers, vouchers, stock, bill-wise outstanding and GST on your phone. A sync agent on the Tally PC sends data here; open the web UI on your phone and install it to the home screen.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the phone app and the sync agent

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Synced Tally data (can always be rebuilt by a full sync)

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Password you type in the phone app

Config.Name: Sync token
Config.Description: Secret shared with the Tally PC sync agent (Setup.bat asks for it)
